python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, time
commands = [
    "python3 -m pytest tests/test_cache_store.py tests/test_history_store.py tests/test_history_routes.py tests/test_settings.py -q",
    "test -s .gsd/milestones/M012/slices/S04/S04-ASSESSMENT.md && rg -n '^## (Do now|Do next|Later|Leave alone)' .gsd/milestones/M012/slices/S04/S04-ASSESSMENT.md",
    "rg -n 'WAL|helper|persistence|history replay' .gsd/DECISIONS.md",
]
results = []
for cmd in commands:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
    duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
    print(f"$ {cmd}")
    print(f"exit_code={proc.returncode} duration_ms={duration_ms}")
    if proc.stdout.strip():
        print(proc.stdout.strip())
    if proc.stderr.strip():
        print(proc.stderr.strip())
    print("---")
    results.append({
        "command": cmd,
        "exitCode": proc.returncode,
        "durationMs": duration_ms,
        "verdict": "✅ pass" if proc.returncode == 0 else "❌ fail",
    })
print("RESULTS_JSON=" + json.dumps(results))
